title: Can and can't
summary: Say what you can and can't do with `-(y)Abil` and `-(y)AmA` (*yüzebilirim*, *gelemem*, *bulamadım*), ask for permission, make polite requests and say what may happen, and use *kimse*, *hiçbir şey* and *hiç* with a negative verb.
canDo: Say what you can and can't do: sports, music, languages
Ask for permission and make polite requests
Turn down an invitation and say why
Say that nobody came or that you saw nothing, and ask whether someone has ever done something
